proposal.reason: Primary change is the review/merge workflow itself: .github/scripts/review_automation.py and maintainer_approval.py rewrite module classification, invitation persistence, and required-approval enforcement, while review-routing/review-gate/review-module/review-squash-preview workflows and commit_message_squash.py restructure squash-preview generation/cleanup and attribution-policy checks. Changes in SKILL/docs/modules.json are supporting policy/documentation updates for the same workflow behavior, not separate runtime modules.
